understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all goals had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved in 3-pixel grid increments using directional actions. Walls and boundaries could block movement, while adjacent pushable blocks could potentially be moved along with a piece. Movement-blocked indicators were only hints and did not always guarantee failure. Multiple selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK with their pixel coordinates, and each action consumed one step from the level's finite budget.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all goals had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved in 3-pixel grid increments using directional actions. Walls and boundaries could block movement, while adjacent pushable blocks could potentially be moved along with a piece. Movement-blocked indicators were only hints and did not always guarantee failure. Multiple selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK with their pixel coordinates, and each action consumed one step from the level's finite budget.
